negative_findings.description: No dedicated, SK-specific banking-technology trade fair or exhibition with a published exhibitor floor plan was found. Unlike larger CEE markets, Slovakia appears to have no equivalent of a standalone payments/banking-tech expo; vendor presence is expressed through sponsor tiers at general IT (ITAPA), fintech (Finweek) or association (ZBK) events instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched sk and en for veľtrh/výstava/expo + banky/platby; only general career and health expos and the ITAPA EXPO zone surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must not assume an exhibitor-list format; the roster signal has to be reconstructed from partner logo walls and agendas across several events.

negative_findings.description: The term 'Zlatý dukát' as a Slovak banking award produced no results; it appears not to be an SK award name (possible confusion with Czech usage or with the coin product).
negative_findings.result_summary: Query returned only Zlatá minca, TREND Banka roka and Mastercard Awards; no 'Zlatý dukát' SK award.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated award entity entering the actor map; confirms Zlatá minca is the dominant SK product-award brand.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm a standing dedicated banking section ('banková sekcia') within ITAPA. Search surfaced ITAPA Health & Care and general digitalisation programmes; banking relevance at ITAPA appears indirect (state digital identity, eID, eDOKLADY) rather than a named financial track.
negative_findings.result_summary: ITAPA programme pages examined via search results only; no banking track identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ITAPA should be treated as an indirect/vendor-mapping source for banking rather than a direct banking-agenda source; downgrade expectations for banking-specific agenda mining there.

negative_findings.description: Individual per-edition ITAPA partner/exhibitor listing pages were not retrieved in this pass — only the hub pages (/virtualna-vystava-itapa-partnerov/, /archiv-podujati/) were identified. The specific logo-wall URLs per year remain unresolved and unverified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hub URLs identified; per-year partner list URLs not enumerated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection pass must crawl rather than fetch fixed URLs; a naive single-URL fetch will miss the multi-year sponsor history that gives this cell its timing value.

negative_findings.description: The organiser and canonical domain of the 'IT vo finančníctve' conference (Bratislava, Austria Trend hotel) was not resolved; it is currently reachable only through the konferencie.sk/education.sk aggregator listing and a pravnenoviny.sk write-up.
negative_findings.result_summary: Aggregator listing found; organiser homepage not identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is potentially the single most on-target SK banking-IT agenda; failing to resolve its organiser leaves the highest-relevance vendor roster unharvested.

negative_findings.description: Qubit Conference Slovakia advertises a deliberately 'vendor-free' programme and no sponsor/partner roster was located in this pass, only speaker pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Speaker page found; partner/sponsor page not located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For this event the exploitable signal is speaker affiliation, not sponsorship — collection method must differ from Finweek/ITAPA.

coverage_gaps.description: Several event root domains (fintechroadmap.cz, amcham.sk event archive, the 'IT vo finančníctve' organiser) were inferred from press coverage rather than fetched directly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Deterministic liveness pass should probe these roots plus the specific partner/speaker subpaths; treat any 403 as bot-defended, not dead.

coverage_gaps.description: Sponsor rosters are ephemeral — event sites routinely replace last year's partner wall with the current edition's, so multi-year sponsorship trend data is at risk.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Wayback Machine snapshot retrieval (web.archive.org) for finweek.sk/partners, itapa.sk partner pages and zlataminca.sk nomination pages to reconstruct 3-5 year sponsor histories.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn event pages and company posts (Slovak Fintech Association, Qubit Conference, individual vendors) carry sponsorship and attendance announcements that never reach the event websites, but were not collected here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide on a policy for LinkedIn — ToS restricts automated collection; consider manual/analyst-assisted capture of event pages only.

coverage_gaps.description: CEE-wide events with SK participation (Prague/Vienna/Budapest payments and banking summits, Efma/Money20/20-style circuits) were only lightly probed via FinTech Roadmap; SK banks and their vendors are likely visible on those rosters too.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up CEE sweep filtering speaker affiliations for SK banks (SLSP, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB, 365.bank, Prima banka, UniCredit SK) and SK-registered vendors.

coverage_gaps.description: Visa-run SK awards, ATM/self-service and core-banking vendor user-group events, and any SBA/ZBK internal award were not located; only the Mastercard-run award was confirmed as a scheme award.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search sk for 'Visa ocenenie Slovensko', 'používateľská konferencia' + core banking vendor names, and check ZBK aktuality archive for further scheme awards.

coverage_gaps.description: Agendas are frequently published as PDFs or in JS-rendered conference apps (program.itapa.sk), which plain HTML fetching will miss.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Include PDF extraction and a headless-browser fallback in the collection method for agenda and partner pages.

brief: Slovakia has no standalone banking-technology trade fair, so the paid-declaration signal this cell targets is distributed across four layers: a general IT congress with a partner logo wall and its own project award (ITAPA / Cena ITAPA), one genuinely on-target fintech-banking conference with tiered commercial sponsors and an expo tier (Finweek Bratislava, 10th edition Oct 2026, with Visa, Thunes, CRIF and NBS/MF SR patronage), an association-run seminar circuit for cards and payments (ZBK, with SBA and NBS alongside), and a cluster of annual awards whose shortlists name specific bank products — Zlatá minca (nominations published, not just winners, since 2005), the scheme-run Mastercard Awards Slovensko carried by Forbes SK, TREND Banka roka and Finparáda. The highest-value and least-exploited item found is the narrowly targeted 'IT vo finančníctve' conference for banks and insurers, whose organiser domain remains unresolved and should be the first action on the next pass. Because sponsor walls are overwritten each edition, the practical risk to this cell is temporal rather than access-related: Wayback snapshots of partner and nomination pages are needed to turn one-off rosters into the multi-year competitive-timing series that makes the signal worth anything.
